imprint.title: Imprint
imprint.subtitle: Information about the operator of this website

sections.heading: Operator
sections.body: This web application is operated privately and non-commercially for the gaming guild „AOEM Server #ERA003“ (Age of Empires Mobile). It is a fan-made tool for internal management of DKP, auctions and guild statistics.

sections.heading: Responsible person
list: Responsible under Art. 3 lit. j Swiss FADP and § 5 TMG (Germany, where applicable): tYPLi1
Location: Switzerland

sections.heading: Contact
list: Use the „Contact“ button at the bottom of every page — your message reaches the operator by email.
Discord: tYPLi1

sections.heading: About the guild
sections.body: „AOEM Server #ERA003“ refers to a player community in the game Age of Empires Mobile. This website is not affiliated with Tencent, Timi Studio Group, Microsoft, World's Edge or other rights holders. All game names, logos and trademarks belong to their respective owners.

sections.heading: Disclaimer
sections.body: Content is created with great care. No warranty is given for accuracy, completeness or timeliness. As the tool is operated privately and free of charge, there is no claim to availability.

sections.heading: External links
sections.body: External links (e.g. Discord, game publishers) are the sole responsibility of their operators. At the time of linking, no illegal content was identifiable.

sections.heading: Copyright
sections.body: Code, design and self-created content are subject to Swiss copyright law (URG). Reproduction or reuse only with the operator's consent.

legal.footerNote: This is a private fan-made guild management tool. Not affiliated with any game publisher.

sections.heading: 1. Introduction
sections.body: This DKP System is a private, non-commercial guild management tool. We respect your privacy and only process the minimal data needed to operate the service. This policy explains what we collect, why, and your rights.

sections.heading: 2. Data we collect
list: In-game player name (manually entered by guild admins).
DKP balance, transaction history, auction bids, and penalty records related to gameplay.
Optional: power values, event participation entered by admins.
Optional: name and message you enter when submitting a bug/feedback report.
Technical data: browser user-agent and the page path when you submit a report.

sections.heading: 3. What we do NOT collect
list: No real names, addresses, phone numbers, or government IDs.
No payment data — the service is free.
No tracking cookies, no advertising, no third-party analytics profiling.

sections.heading: 4. Legal basis (Swiss FADP / GDPR / KVKK)
sections.body: Data controller: tYPLi1 (Switzerland), operator of the AOEM Server #ERA003 tool. We process data based on your consent (Art. 6 Swiss FADP) and the legitimate interest of operating the guild. For EU users the GDPR additionally applies. Swiss supervisory authority: Federal Data Protection and Information Commissioner (FDPIC), www.edoeb.admin.ch. Data is strictly limited to what is necessary.

sections.heading: 5. Data storage & security
sections.body: Data is hosted on the Base44 platform with industry-standard security. Servers may be located outside Turkey/EU. By using this service you acknowledge that your data may be transferred internationally.

sections.heading: 6. Sharing
sections.body: We do not sell, rent, or share your data with advertisers. DKP balances and rankings are visible publicly to all visitors of this guild site (this is the purpose of the tool). Discord notifications may include your in-game name and ranking.

sections.heading: 7. Retention
sections.body: Player and DKP data is kept as long as the guild operates the system. Bug reports are kept until resolved. You can request deletion at any time (see contact).

sections.heading: 8. Your rights
list: Right of access — request what data we hold about you.
Right to rectification — ask us to correct inaccurate data.
Right to erasure — ask us to delete your player record.
Right to object — withdraw consent and stop using the service.

sections.heading: 9. Contact
sections.body: For any privacy request, use the „Contact“ button at the bottom of every page (sends an email to the operator) or contact tYPLi1 via Discord. Response usually within 30 days.

sections.heading: 1. Acceptance
sections.body: By accessing this DKP System, you agree to these Terms. If you do not agree, please do not use the service.

sections.heading: 2. Nature of the service
sections.body: This is a free, private, non-commercial tool used by a gaming guild to track DKP (Dragon Kill Points), auctions, and penalties. It is provided “as is” without warranty of any kind.

sections.heading: 3. Acceptable use
list: Do not attempt to disrupt, hack, or overload the service.
Do not submit false, harassing, or unlawful content via reports.
Do not use the service for any commercial purpose.
Respect other guild members.

sections.heading: 4. Accounts & access
sections.body: Admin access is granted by the guild leadership. Public visitors can view leaderboards and results without an account. Misuse of admin credentials may result in revocation.

sections.heading: 5. Intellectual property
sections.body: The DKP System code, design, and content (excluding game data and user-submitted information) belong to the guild operators. You may not copy or redistribute the system without permission.

sections.heading: 6. Disclaimer
sections.body: The service is provided “as is”. We do not guarantee uptime, accuracy, or fitness for any particular purpose. We are not liable for any loss arising from use of the service.

sections.heading: 7. Changes
sections.body: We may update these Terms at any time. Continued use after changes means you accept the updated Terms.

sections.heading: 8. Governing law
sections.body: Swiss law applies, excluding the UN Convention on Contracts for the International Sale of Goods. Place of jurisdiction is the operator's domicile in Switzerland, to the extent legally permitted.

sections.heading: 9. Contact
sections.body: Questions about these Terms can be sent via the „Contact“ button at the bottom of every page or to tYPLi1 via Discord.

kvkk.title: KVKK Notice
kvkk.subtitle: Information notice under Turkish Personal Data Protection Law (KVKK No. 6698)

sections.heading: 1. Data Controller
sections.body: The guild administration operates this DKP System as the data controller (“veri sorumlusu”). For inquiries, contact your guild admin via Discord.

sections.heading: 2. Personal data processed
list: In-game player name (a pseudonym, not necessarily a real name).
DKP, auction bid history, penalties, power values.
Optional contact name and message via the bug report form.

sections.heading: 3. Purpose of processing (Article 5)
sections.body: Data is processed solely for managing guild membership, fairly distributing DKP and auction slots, and improving the service. Processing is based on the explicit consent of the data subject and the legitimate interest of the guild.

sections.heading: 4. International transfer (Article 9)
sections.body: The service is hosted on infrastructure that may be located outside the Republic of Turkey. By using this service you give your explicit consent (“açık rıza”) to the transfer of your data abroad for the purposes described above.

sections.heading: 5. Your rights (Article 11)
list: Learn whether your personal data is processed.
Request information about the processing.
Learn the purpose and whether data is used in accordance with that purpose.
Know third parties to whom data is transferred (we do not transfer to advertisers).
Request correction of incomplete or inaccurate data.
Request deletion of your data within the framework of Article 7.
Object to results unfavorable to you arising from automated analysis.
Request compensation for damage suffered due to unlawful processing.

sections.heading: 6. How to exercise your rights
sections.body: Submit your request via the „Contact“ button at the bottom of every page (delivered to the operator by email) or to your guild admin via Discord. We will respond within 30 days as required by KVKK.

sections.heading: 7. Storage period
sections.body: Data is stored as long as you are an active guild member. Upon request or upon leaving the guild, your personal data will be deleted or anonymized.

sections.heading: 8. Security measures
sections.body: We apply technical and organizational measures appropriate to the nature of the data: secure hosting, access control, password hashing, and minimal data collection.
